newsitem.title: CHINA: China cautions Japan on security plan.
newsitem.headline: China cautions Japan on security plan.

text.p: China cautioned Japan on Tuesday to act carefully to avoid bringing instability to the Asian-Pacific with its strengthened security ties with the United States.

"We hope Japan can take lessons from history by acting cautiously and walking the road of peaceful development," Foreign Ministry spokesman Cui Tiankai told reporters in reply to a question on the security pact.
"The Japan-U.S. security alliance is a bilateral arrangement formed during the Cold War," the spokesman said.
"With the end of the Cold War, there is no reason for this kind of arrangement to go beyond the scope of the two sides," he said.
He added that limiting cooperation would avoid bringing instability to Asian-Pacific countries.

Japan and the United States decided on Sunday to send emissaries to China to explain stepped up security cooperation between the two countries in a move that would give Tokyo its highest military profile since World War Two.
